query: UPDATE assistant_conversations SET state=CASE WHEN $4 THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'ended' END,deleted_at=CASE WHEN $4 THEN coalesce(deleted_at,now()) ELSE deleted_at END,revision=revision+1,title=CASE WHEN $4 THEN '' ELSE title END WHERE workspace_id=$1 AND user_id=$2 AND id=$3 AND state<>CASE WHEN $4 THEN 'deleted' ELSE 'ended' END
